name: Symbol of Healing
summary: Create a symbol that heals nearby creatures or harms those vulnerable to positive energy.
description: Use the trigger rules of Symbol of Death. When triggered, the symbol affects creatures within 60 feet. It heals 2d8 plus one hit point per caster level (maximum +15). Creatures harmed by positive energy instead take that amount of damage, halved on a successful Will save. A creature can be affected once per 24 hours. The triggered symbol stays active for 10 minutes per caster level. A caster of at least 10th level can make it permanent with Permanency for 10,000 gp.
components: M (mercury, phosphorus, powdered diamond and opal worth 500 gp)
